scientific_scope_status: The completed P1 recovery reports an executable conditional transport of an EXISTING recorded Bernoulli bit, then exact joint-law repair of a fixed acyclic binary computation from sample-only old/new local callbacks. Under explicit subcritical propagation conditions, expected repair work depends on the edit. The fixed-policy1,398,101-variable execution averaged17.42newflips/edit versus22.31for a stronger time-only method and2189.01for independent LOCAL resampling. A separately depth-tuned comparison gave16.18versus22.10with offline benchmark-probability acquisition uncharged.

unavailable_or_unclassified: The old trace is paid and distributed as the old generative law; the graph, full stored bits, edited nodes and structured old/new conditional sampling at specified parents are supplied. Simple exact-Q repair/ensemble claims require a fixed edit or one independent of simulation randomness. They are not fresh adaptive-experiment claims. Fixed graph/acyclic binary structure is binding. Coupling error increases propagation rather than biasing the target marginal. Full output materialization and initial simulation remain linear work. Freshness lower bounds do not rule out correlated repair. All reported counts are ideal source flips, not physical calendar windows. No general inference speedup, independent review, priority or hardware performance is established; the visible executable core is not rerun or exported.
